description: Returns ONE series' CURATED preset ideas (the authored cards the webapp shows on its idea step). Free, instant, creates nothing. THIS IS NOT THE DEFAULT WAY TO GET AN IDEA: invent three of your own, one line each, and sharpen them with the user in chat; call this only when the user asks what the SERIES itself suggests ('show me the ones from the app'). Then offer at most 3, one line each, as the series' own presets, ending 'or tell me yours'; never paste an idea's full text or send one to `generate_story_video` unchanged without the user choosing it. What you pass as `idea` is one short paragraph in the user's own terms: you never author scenes, dialogue or image prompts. An empty `ideas` list means the series ships none (`input.has_idea_presets` on its full `list_series` entry says so up front). 404 = unknown series id.

series_id.description: The series id, exactly as `list_series` returns it.
